description: This file defines an immutable implementation of the SubjectIssuer interface, encapsulating a subject issuer string with methods for creation, String-like access, and equality checks.

classes.name: ImmutableSubjectIssuer
classes.description: An immutable class implementing the SubjectIssuer interface, encapsulating a subject issuer string and providing standard String methods for access and comparison.
